mapper.select: /* Attd02Mapper.selectHolidayId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{gvCmpnyCd}, 'HOLIDAY_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* Attd02Mapper.selectHolidayRuleId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{gvCmpnyCd}, 'HOLIDAY_RULE_ID')) FROM DUAL
mapper.update: /* Attd02Mapper.updateHolidayRule */ INSERT INTO TB_HOLIDAY_RULE ( CMPNY_CD , HOLIDAY_RULE_ID , HOLIDAY_RULE_NM , HOLIDAY_MM , HOLIDAY_DD , HOLIDAY_TYPE , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{holidayId} , #{holidayNm} , SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{holidayYmd}, '-', ''), 5, 2) , SUBSTR(REPLACE(#{holidayYmd}, '-', ''), 7, 2) , #{holidayType} , COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y') , COALESCE(#{gvUserCd}, 'SYSTEM') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{gvUserCd}, 'SYSTEM') , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE HOLIDAY_RULE_NM = NEW.HOLIDAY_RULE_NM , HOLIDAY_MM = NEW.HOLIDAY_MM , HOLIDAY_DD = NEW.HOLIDAY_DD , HOLIDAY_TYPE = NEW.HOLIDAY_TYPE , USE_YN = NEW.USE_YN , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()

/* Attd02Mapper.updateHolidayRule */ INSERT INTO TB_HOLIDAY ( CMPNY_CD , HOLIDAY_ID , HOLIDAY_NM , HOLIDAY_YMD , HOLIDAY_TYPE , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{holidayId} , #{holidayNm} , STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{holidayYmd}, '-', ''), '%Y%m%d') , #{holidayType} , COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y') , COALESCE(#{gvUserCd}, 'SYSTEM') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{gvUserCd}, 'SYSTEM') , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE HOLIDAY_NM = NEW.HOLIDAY_NM , HOLIDAY_YMD = NEW.HOLIDAY_YMD , HOLIDAY_TYPE = NEW.HOLIDAY_TYPE , USE_YN = NEW.USE_YN , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
